newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close off as CANTV euphoria eludes.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close off as CANTV euphoria eludes.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed soft as investors unwound long positions as the long expected CANTV -led rally failed to materialize, brokers said.
The market's index slipped 1.66 percent to close at 6,109.43 points as 23 stocks fell, 12 rose and seven closed flat.
"The local market was long, hoping that when CANTV came to the market prices would soar," said one trader. "But that hasn't happened yet, so some sold-off today," he added.
Brokers added trade houses were still clearing their books after CANTV's Friday placement, and that had stunted trade.
A total of nine million shares traded, worth 2.2 billion bolivars ($4.7 million).
"It was a slow shallow market," said Multinvest broker Jose Gregorio Tineo.

Among leading stocks, CANTV slipped 4.00 bolivars to close at 1716.00, Electricidad de Caracas lost 19.50 to end at 520.50 bolivars, foods company Mavesa lost 3.00 bolivars to finish at 148.50 and steel company Sivensa dropped 14.00 bolivars to end at 338.00.
